title: Tiered EU/UK retention & subprocessor clauses for enterprise packaging experiment
creator: Leah Chen
description: Background: Enterprise prospects frequently request explicit EU/UK residency guarantees, tighter retention windows, and detailed subprocessor disclosure. Our current offer bundles residency as a one-size feature for Dedicated/Private, but sales require a menu of contractual options tied to pricing tiers and clear subprocessor acceptance/notification language. Goal: Define a tiered set of residency/retention/subprocessor contractual options, model associated price deltas, and run a small A/B pricing experiment with 3 pilot customers. Deliverables: 1) Contract clause library: short-form clauses for (a) EU-only residency, (b) EU+UK residency, (c) customer-managed on-prem/VPC with audit windows; retention tiers 7/30/90/365 days with associated logging/audit obligations. 2) Subprocessor policy matrix: allowed subprocessors per tier, notification cadence, approval SLA. 3) SCCs / UK Addendum plan: recommended wording and guardrails for including SCCs + UK Addendum in each template variant. 4) Pricing experiment plan: hypothesis, target cohort (existing Enterprise signups + 3 active pilots), offer construction (baseline plus residency/retention addons), metrics (conversion lift, ARR delta, negotiation friction time, legal review rounds). 5) Implementation checklist for Contract Operations + Sales Engineering: template updates, intake workflow for approvals, billing SKU mappings, and console flags for routing requests to private deployments. Success criteria: - Two pilot customers commit to a paid residency add-on within 8 weeks OR - Pricing experiment shows >=10% willingness-to-pay for 30-day retention upgrade AND negotiation cycle does not exceed baseline by >25% Stakeholders: Marco Alvarez (PM owner), Priya Menon (Legal, contracts), Owen Park (Sales Eng), Samira Idris (Revenue Ops), Leah Chen (product lead on packaging). Risks and guardrails: - Risk: Overly permissive subprocessors in a tier may expose customers; mitigate by legal-approved baseline and mandatory notification. - Risk: Price complexity reduces conversion; mitigate by limiting to 2-3 clear tiers and an anchored base price. - Compliance note: Any template that delegates data-controller obligations must pass privacy counsel review; also include data transfer mechanisms checklist (SCCs, Supplementary Measures). Next steps: 1) Converge clause language with Legal (Priya) by 2026-03-05 [DONE]. 2) Produce pricing matrix and proposed SKU mapping by 2026-03-12 [IN PROGRESS]. 3) Prepare pilot contract addendum and send to 3 pilot prospects by 2026-03-18. 4) Instrument checkout and sales dashboard to capture offer responses and negotiation timestamps by 2026-03-25.
